channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: OEG Energy Group Enhances Operational Efficiency with AST Reygar’s IRAMS Technology
item.description: AST Reygar announced its ongoing support to OEG Energy Group, a leading provider of temporary power and engineering solutions for the offshore industry, by delivering additional IRAMS satellite monitoring units to enhance operational efficiency and offshore asset management.

item.title: Uncovering How Faults and Mobile Shale Control Methane Seepage in the Gulf of Mexico
item.description: New research from Tulane University is reshaping scientific understanding of how methane escapes from the seafloor in the Gulf of Mexico. A master’s thesis by Walee Yeboah, a recent graduate of the Department of Earth and Environmental Science, reveals that active faults and mobile shale structures beneath the seafloor play a critical role in directing methane and fluid migration—challenging long-standing assumptions that salt tectonics alone dominate seepage patterns in the region.

item.title: Viridien and SLB Announce Agreement with EGAS for Large Multi-Client OBN Program Over Eastern Mediterranean Offshore
item.description: Viridien and SLB have entered into an agreement with the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (EGAS) to launch a massive multi-client ocean bottom node (OBN) seismic acquisition and imaging program in Egypt’s Eastern Mediterranean offshore.

item.title: UKDI Backs Joint Project on Autonomous Underwater Sensing
item.description: A first-of-its-kind project to develop a network of ocean robots to assure the successful operations of submersible fleet assets has launched this month, following a successful funding bid with UK Defence Innovation (UKDI), previously known as the Defense and Security Accelerator (DASA), between ZeroUSV, Oshen, and MarineAI.

item.title: Raytheon Selected by DARPA to Develop Advanced Maritime Defense Technologies
item.description: Raytheon, an RTX business, has been selected by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) to develop an advanced sensing and targeting system that will help defend vulnerable commercial shipping and naval logistics vessels against emerging threats such as unmanned surface vehicles (USVs).

item.title: McDermott Secures Landmark Definition Engineering Contract for Qatar’s First Major Offshore Decommissioning Project
item.description: McDermott has been awarded a decommissioning definition engineering contract by QatarEnergy for the State of Qatar's inaugural offshore decommissioning initiative.

item.title: Maritime Technologies Forum Highlights Key Activities in Its 2025 Annual Report
item.description: The Maritime Technologies Forum (MTF) has released its annual report highlighting recent publications and events organized to promote the safe decarbonization of the maritime industry.

item.title: TGS Signs Letter of Intent with Subsidiary of Libya National Oil Corporation
item.description: TGS, a global provider of energy data and intelligence, announced the signing of a Letter of Intent (LOI) with North Africa Geophysical Company (NAGECO), a subsidiary of the Libyan National Oil Corporation (NOC), marking an important step toward expanding multi-client data activities in Libya.

item.title: Candela P-12 Completes World’s Longest Electric Sea Journey
item.description: Demonstrating that electric passenger vessels are no longer confined to short, fixed routes—or dependent on costly, purpose-built charging infrastructure—the world’s first electric hydrofoiling ferry, Candela P-12, has completed a record-breaking voyage from Sweden’s west coast to Norway’s capital, Oslo.

item.title: Underwater 3D Printing Could Transform Maritime Construction
item.description: A group of Cornell researchers is developing a way to bring the technology to the ocean. By 3D-printing concrete underwater, the new approach could transform on-site maritime construction and the repair of critical infrastructure that connects continents.
